ready: Two independent skill families support the same bounded principal/resource/operation/control/evidence task slice while residual full/broad/differential duties remain separated.
One fixed real project/ref supplies independently grounded source-supported failure, upstream-control refutation, and deployment-dependent unknown conditions with isolated inputs and oracles.
Declared obligations, source discovery, and evidence support have separate denominators and failure/change behavior.
Structure, evidence presence, evidence support, and task correctness have distinct judges; useful and excessive abstention are defined.
A complete paper walkthrough transfers across the Cloudflare/GitHub guidance without repository-specific fields, and an independent read-only review found no material correction.
The first consumption path is bounded to exact fixed context, zero model tools, and existing structured-provider/run infrastructure.
boundedQuestions: No model has consumed B or D, so task correctness, trace quality, false-completeness behavior, repair rate, and cost are unknown.
The evidence panel is one project/ref; cross-project reuse and active discovery are untested.
Structured fallback currently undercounts a preceding failed tool-use response unless per-attempt telemetry is added.
No authoring trace justifies a second representation; author representation value remains deferred.
No target code, PoC, regression test, deployment, prospective, held-out, readiness, or formal effect experiment was run.
notReadyFor: production DSL or public general-purpose authorization language
